name: toollib-build-vendor
description: Bundles the libraries behind Toollib's services into vendor/git.js, vendor/search.js, vendor/katex/katex.js, vendor/reader.js, vendor/pdfjs/ and vendor/editor/.

scripts.build: npm run build:git && npm run build:search && npm run build:katex && npm run build:reader && npm run build:pdfjs && npm run build:editor
scripts.build:katex: esbuild entry-katex.js --bundle --format=esm --minify --target=es2020,safari15 --legal-comments=none --outfile=out/katex/katex.js && cp node_modules/katex/dist/katex.min.css out/katex/ && mkdir -p out/katex/fonts && cp node_modules/katex/dist/fonts/*.woff2 out/katex/fonts/ && cp node_modules/katex/LICENSE out/katex/
scripts.build:pdfjs: mkdir -p out/pdfjs && cp node_modules/pdfjs-dist/legacy/build/pdf.min.mjs node_modules/pdfjs-dist/legacy/build/pdf.worker.min.mjs out/pdfjs/ && cp node_modules/pdfjs-dist/LICENSE out/pdfjs/
scripts.build:editor: esbuild entry-editor.js entry-editor-langs.js --bundle --splitting --format=esm --minify --target=es2020,safari15 --legal-comments=none --outdir=out/editor --entry-names=[name] --chunk-names=editor-shared && mv out/editor/entry-editor.js out/editor/editor.js && mv out/editor/entry-editor-langs.js out/editor/editor-langs.js && cp node_modules/@codemirror/view/LICENSE out/editor/
